heading: Powers
lead: The corporation has only the powers provided in its bylaws and articles of incorporation filed in each State in which it is incorporated.

notes.text: Historical and Revision Notes RevisedSectionSource (U.S. Code)Source (Statutes at Large) 6010636:4802.Nov. 5, 1990, Pub. L. 101–510, title XVI, § 1602, 104 Stat. 1736. The words “and subject to the laws of such State or States” are omitted as unnecessary.
